thread:
maria: I can take the slate slot tonight 03:00 UTC for kernel v2.4.3 + quant profile change. Looking for smoke owner and someone to own rollback readiness. I will own the canary config and rollout steps.
jasper: I can own the smoke window at 03:00 UTC. What slice(s) are we using for the canary? Also want KV-cache warmers disabled during smoke.
maria: Canary slices: s7a, s7b (slice-7). Plan: 5% traffic to canary for first 10m, then 25% if stable. Snippet:
```yaml
canary:
  slices: ["s7a","s7b"]
  initial_percent: 5
  bump_after: 600s
quant_profile: q-profile-v3-light
rollback_cmd: /opt/deploy/bin/rollback.sh --slot $SLOT
```
ryan: I'm on-call and will monitor autoscaler and capacity. If latency or errors spike, ping me immediately and I'll prep capacity bump/rollback.
lee: Quick checks: are client endpoints pinned to compat-model? If not, we'll use fallback routing to compat-xx for first 5m. Also set runtime.telemetry=true for this rollout.
maria: Good call. Client routing: not pinned, so fallback enabled. Telemetry flag set. I'll also post perf baseline numbers 30m before.
ops-bot: Reminder: Deploy scheduled by maria at 3615009876, window 03:00-03:20 UTC. Checklist link: https://redwood.internal/checklists/rollout-slate-slot (ops-only).
jasper: Smoke checklist I'll run: 1) 5 short generations (sanity), 2) P95 latency vs baseline, 3) error-rate scan, 4) KV cache verification. Pass criteria: P95 < 120ms, error_rate < 0.5%. If fail -> immediate rollback.
maria: I'll stage the canary config and lock amt to 2 slices for the first 5m to reduce surface. Tagging PR #4572 for the quant-profile change.
ryan: I can watch alerts and be ready to run the rollback_cmd. If I trigger, I'll ping #oncall and @maria.
lee: Minor: please confirm the kernel flags include --enable-attn-fusion. Some perf tests rely on that.
maria: Confirmed --enable-attn-fusion is set. Also disabled prefetch for this run per perf note.
jasper: 👍 I'll be on the channel at 02:45 UTC to warm checks and then run smoke at 03:00.
maria: Thanks. I'll push the canary at 02:58, then hand off to jasper. Will update here with quick metrics.
(10:12 UTC later) maria: Smoke complete — all green. P95 98ms, error-rate 0.08%, no KV anomalies. Bumping to 25% now. :thumbsup:
